topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, I'll be. 'Tis said that young Ser Thomas hath found his likeness branded upon the flesh of a man, as if by a skilled hand. I reckon the young master must've made his mark, drawing images that others wish to carry with them always. To think, his art's become so valued it's etched onto skin; 'tis a fine honor, I reckon. We peasants might not know much of high art, but we do know the worth of a good harvest, and Ser Thomas, he's reaped a bountiful one indeed with his brush and ink. May the saints guide his path and keep his art lively and bright.
